name: TC-BDM-03: lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Body Makers
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UtilityPages/BodyMakers.cy.js#UtilityPages - BodyMakers [en] — Body Makers TC-BDM-03: lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Body Makers
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-BDM-03
**Title:** Lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Body Makers
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Body Makers page, open the lead form via "Talk To Dealer", fill a valid name, an invalid (5-digit) mobile number, and leave city/brand/model empty, then submit.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown mobile-format and other required validation messages are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Body Makers page
2. Click a dealer card's "Talk To Dealer" button to open its lead form
3. Fill a valid name and an invalid mobile number
4. Submit with city, brand and model left empty
5. Verify the mobile-format and other validation messages are shown
